text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #23313d

g.text: An X-bar chart monitors subgroup means against control limits, not specification limits

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Assigned subgroup means with known stable baseline mean10 mm and within-process SD0.08 mm. Limits apply to subgroup means, not individual parts. One
beyond-limit point triggers investigation under the stated rule, not proof of a specific cause. Specifications are intentionally absent. A chart alone does
not certify capability or establish its own valid baseline.
